summary: This article showcases six fusion family recipes from multicultural households, each blending the heritages of a couple into a single dish. Examples include Jerk Chicken Alfredo, Pho-rench Onion Soup, Curry Arroz con Pollo, Sushi Burgers, Kimchi Borscht and Mole Turkey. It argues that such dishes carry stories of love, identity and global interconnectedness.
one_line: Six multicultural families share fusion recipes, such as Jerk Chicken Alfredo and Kimchi Borscht, that blend their heritages and reflect global connection.
key_facts: The Smith-Johnsons, Maria Smith (Italian roots) and David Johnson (Jamaican heritage), serve Jerk Chicken Alfredo, first shown at dinner on September 10, 2023.

Jerk Chicken Alfredo combines Jamaican jerk seasoning with creamy Italian Alfredo sauce over al dente pasta; Maria recalls her grandmother's fettuccine Alfredo and David his father's backyard jerk stand.
Thuy Nguyen and Julien LeBlanc created "Pho-rench" Onion Soup on November 5, 2023, merging Vietnamese Pho with French Onion Soup.
Pho-rench Onion Soup uses Thuy's mother's Pho broth secrets with caramelized onions and melty Gruyère cheese from Julien's French heritage, plus ginger and star anise.
Anjali Patel and Mateo Castro met in culinary school in 2023 and shared Curry Arroz con Pollo on December 15, 2023.
Curry Arroz con Pollo pairs Anjali's cumin, coriander and turmeric with Mateo's slow-cooked chicken and rice.
The Anderson-Hirata family served sushi burgers at a family reunion on September 17, 2023: a patty between rice buns seasoned with soy sauce and wasabi.
Emily Anderson contributes American beef burger barbecue heritage, while Taro Hirata contributes his Japanese mother's sushi-rolling tradition; the burger includes seaweed and pickled ginger.
Natasha Russo (Russian) and her husband Min-ho Lee (Korean) invented Kimchi Borscht, shared on Lunar New Year, February 1, 2024.
Kimchi Borscht blends earthy beetroot borscht with spicy fermented kimchi and is associated with celebrations by their children.
The Gonzalez-Riley family introduced Mole Turkey on Thanksgiving, November 30, 2023, replacing gravy with Ana Gonzalez's abuela's chocolatey Mexican mole.
Mole Turkey uses Patrick Riley's brined and butter-basted turkey.
The article frames fusion cuisine as a mirror of an evolving society and global heritage.
